div.head: VI As 6.2
div.ab: Et bos una manca (id est XXX den.) et uacca XX den. et porcus X den. et ouis solido (V den.) persoluatur.
⁊ oxan to mancuse ⁊ cú to XX ⁊ swyn to X ⁊ sceap to scll'.
⁊ oxan to mancuse ⁊ cù to XX ⁊ swyn to X ⁊ sceap to scll.
An ox shall be valued at a mancus and a cow at twenty pence, a pig at ten pence, and a sheep at a shilling.
An an ox [is to be paid for] at a mancus; and a cow at 20 [pence]; and a pig at 10 [pence]; and a sheep at a shilling.
Und einen Ochsen [ersetzen wir dem Genossen taxirt] zu 1 Mancus und eine Kuh zu 20 (Pfennig Quadr.) und ein Schwein zu 10 (Pfennig Quadr.) und ein Schaf zu 1 Schilling.
And an ox [we replace to the fellow-member, valued] at 1 mancus, and a cow at 20 (pence, Quadr.), and a pig at 10 (pence, Quadr.), and a sheep at 1 shilling.
